newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Centre Party still wants govt cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Centre Party still wants govt cooperation.

text.p: Sweden's Centre Party said on Monday it wanted to keep cooperating with the country's minority Social Democratic government, particularly regarding the business climate and unemployment.

"The Centre Party is prepared to follow through its constructive part via discussions with the government about policies for an improved business climate and reduced unemployment," the party board said in a statement.
The board pointed to a party report that is supposed to form a platform for coming negotiations.
"Measures for a business friendly climate and more new entrepeneurs must be strengthened," the party board said.
The Centre Party has had an informal cooperation with the government for more than a year.
